sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: On Monday 27 July, 2:00 pm AEST, AusAlert will send a nationwide test alert to mobile devices. This includes most phones and some smart watches and tablets.

sections.heading: What to expect
sections.text:
Your device will:

- vibrate
- make a siren-like sound for about 10 seconds
- display a test text message.

sections.heading: What you need to do
sections.text:
The test alert will happen automatically.

If the alert could make you or a family member feel unsafe, you can:

- turn your device off, or
- use aeroplane mode.

sections.heading: Why this is happening
sections.text:
AusAlert is a new national emergency warning system.

In an emergency, it will send alerts to tell you:

- what's happening, and
- what you need to do.

sections.heading: More information
sections.text: For more information including a full list of times for all states, visit ausalert.gov.au.
